lesson: The 82 percent North Korea forecast converted repeated visit speculation into a strong but not absolute probability and resolved well. Continue raising geopolitical visit forecasts when multiple independent preparations align while preserving a tail until official confirmation.

London was included but underweighted at 15 percent behind Paris and Berlin, and the forecast was never revisited after opening day. For E3 leader meetings, avoid treating the most diplomatically prominent capital as a default; recent convening patterns and the specific leader driving coordination should receive more weight.

The forecast restricted all five outcomes to Russian or occupied-Crimean Black Sea ports and omitted Romania's major oil port. Maritime drones can drift, be intercepted, or detonate near third-country infrastructure, so location slates should span the full reachable coastline rather than assume the event occurs at the intended adversary target.

A broad role-based Finals distribution correctly ranked Brunson first at 27 percent. For highly specific late-game basketball events, preserve dispersion but lead with the primary high-usage closer rather than overfitting to size or a single play type.

Direct procedural reporting justified the 99.5 percent Senate forecast and resolved almost perfectly. Binary legislative questions can support near-certainty once the named chamber has formally advanced the exact package and the alternative sequence is procedurally foreclosed.
